About KULTURA

KULTURA is a digital scrapbook of Filipino traditions. Each chapter gathers customs that communities still keep today, from small courtesies at home to fiestas, faith, and the living arts of indigenous peoples.

We made it for our Digital Interface and Heritage Design project to show how traditions carry a community’s identity: the shared values, memories, and stories that remind Filipinos who they are.

Open a chapter below or from the Discover map, turn the pages with the colored ribbons, and tap any story to read more.

— Noel, Danahia, Benedict & Dave
